tailoring.headline: eCommerce Product Owner & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years of experience building, integrating and managing enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for global brands at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise bridging business needs and technical delivery through requirements analysis, user stories, product backlog management, REST APIs, and third-party integrations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer skilled in driving digital commerce capabilities and stakeholder alignment.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Consumer Channels eCommerce Product Owner
cover_en.hook: Glanbia's dedication to innovation across world-renowned consumer brands makes this eCommerce Product Owner role an exciting opportunity to drive high-impact digital initiatives. With over five years of hands-on experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms and bridging business needs with technical delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-positioned to lead your digital commerce capabilities.

bullets.label: Roadmap and Backlog Management
bullets.text: Analysed business requirements and translated them into technical deliverables, writing user stories and functional specifications for global SAP Commerce Cloud platforms.

bullets.label: Customer Journey Optimization
bullets.text: Drove improvements across customer journeys by developing Promotions Engines, Order Management capabilities, and search indexing to optimize browse and checkout experiences.

bullets.label: Integrations and Ecosystems
bullets.text: Managed and optimized complex platform integrations, building robust REST APIs, OCC web services, and data pipelines connecting PIM, ERP, and third-party systems.

bullets.label: Stakeholder and Vendor Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and international technical partners to align digital initiatives with commercial and operational goals.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional expertise can support Glanbia's digital channels.

tailoring.why_company: Glanbia's world-renowned consumer brands and commitment to digital innovation present an inspiring environment for an eCommerce Product Owner. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience and techno-functional background to bridge business needs with technical delivery, optimizing customer journeys and driving strategic roadmap initiatives across your digital channels.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce and techno-functional expertise to Glanbia as an eCommerce Product Owner, driving digital capabilities and customer journeys.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an experienced e-commerce professional with 5+ years building enterprise platforms and bridging business needs with technical delivery. I've applied for the Consumer Channels eCommerce Product Owner role at Glanbia and would love to connect about your digital initiatives.
tailoring.email_subject: Application - Consumer Channels eCommerce Product Owner - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Consumer Channels eCommerce Product Owner position at Glanbia.

With over 5 years of experience designing enterprise e-commerce platforms, managing integrations, and bridging business requirements with technical delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your digital channels team.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your product goals. Please note I am serving notice until 15.12.2026, with an earliest start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
